**Topics are real, clickable sub-cards now; the Now card is visible again.** The bulleted wall is a Topics list at the top of the Now card, newest first, titles only, each a click into its own page with a small NEW mark cleared the moment you open it. Replies target one topic's own id, documented on the card.
